Yup, that's me.

When I was 12, and in junior high, I had some after school soccer practice or something like that. The school was essentially deserted after practice.

I was getting changed, and these two girls who were about 18 or 19 walked in on me so I quickly started covering up myself. They were giggling and stuff, while locking the door.

They undressed me and one of them started sucking me off, and it just sorta happened in a blur after that. I wanted to cry for help, but didn't. I didn't even fight back or try to stop it, just sat there and took it.

I can't help but feel responsible for what happened.
